crossRefs.note: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
“Behold, siege ramps have come to the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight…
Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant…
“ ‘This will be the sign to you,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words…
My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among…
The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be…
Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.” ’ ”
“When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall…
Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
translations.bsb: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the dwellers of Samaria. With pride and arrogance of heart they will say:
translations.kjv: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
translations.asv: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in pride and in stoutness of heart,
